bugRegister.title: Contact form submission is a mock simulation; messages are never transmitted
bugRegister.expected: Form submission should POST data to backend endpoint or email service API with confirmation or failure feedback.
bugRegister.actual: Form executes a 500ms setTimeout and sets isSubmitted(true). Messages are permanently discarded in memory.
bugRegister.recommendation: Wire form to a server action or API route (/api/contact) connected to an email dispatch provider.

bugRegister.title: Broken fallback image asset (/images/covers/cover-ramayana.png) returns HTTP 404
bugRegister.expected: Fallback cover image should point to an existing valid asset.
bugRegister.actual: Fallback points to /images/covers/cover-ramayana.png which does not exist in public/images, resulting in 404.
bugRegister.rootCause: Nonexistent directory /images/covers/ referenced in fallback ternaries.

bugRegister.title: Fake Google and Apple OAuth login buttons autofill demo accounts
bugRegister.expected: Social login buttons should initiate third-party OAuth flows, or be clearly labeled as demo credentials buttons.
bugRegister.actual: Clicking 'Sign in with Google' or 'Sign in with Apple' sets hardcoded email and password state.
bugRegister.rootCause: Mock UI controls masquerading as functional third-party authentication.
bugRegister.recommendation: Integrate real OAuth provider or re-label as demo quick-fill helpers.

bugRegister.title: Forgot Password feature uses browser alert() and fake dispatch message
bugRegister.expected: A functional password reset modal or dedicated page requesting email.
bugRegister.actual: Displays alert('Password reset instructions sent to your email.') without checking input.
bugRegister.recommendation: Implement a password reset modal or route with input validation.

bugRegister.title: Potential memory/CPU leak in SmoothScrollProvider: missing cancelAnimationFrame
bugRegister.expected: Animation frame loop should be cancelled with cancelAnimationFrame(id) on unmount.
bugRegister.actual: Loop continues calling requestAnimationFrame indefinitely after Lenis instance is destroyed.
bugRegister.rootCause: Missing raf ID capture and cleanup.
bugRegister.recommendation: Capture requestAnimationFrame ID and call cancelAnimationFrame in useEffect cleanup.

bugRegister.title: SearchModal does not dismiss on Escape key and lacks focus trap
bugRegister.expected: Pressing Escape key should close search modal, and focus should remain trapped while open.
bugRegister.actual: Escape key is ignored. Keyboard tab navigation escapes the modal.
bugRegister.rootCause: Missing keydown event listener and focus containment logic.
bugRegister.recommendation: Add Escape keydown listener and focus trap to SearchModal.

bugRegister.title: Text overflow risk on mobile 320px in PapumbaHero headline
bugRegister.expected: Text should fit comfortably on 320px wide viewports without clipping.
bugRegister.actual: text-[2.8rem] (~44.8px) makes 'storytelling' ~312px wide, exceeding 288px container width.
bugRegister.rootCause: Base font size too large for 320px screens.
bugRegister.recommendation: Use text-[2.2rem] xs:text-[2.5rem] sm:text-[4rem] or break-words.

bugRegister.title: CartDrawer lacks focus trap (WCAG 2.4.3 Focus Order)
bugRegister.expected: Tabbing while drawer is open should cycle only within drawer elements.
bugRegister.actual: Tab key moves focus to background page elements behind the backdrop.
bugRegister.recommendation: Add focus trap utility to CartDrawer.

bugRegister.title: Unused dependency in package.json (split-type)
bugRegister.expected: All declared dependencies should be utilized.
bugRegister.actual: split-type is never imported or used across the codebase.

bugRegister.title: Dead code in AudiobookModal: handleUnlock unreferenced
bugRegister.expected: Defined handlers should be wired to actions or pruned.
bugRegister.actual: handleUnlock is declared in state but never referenced in JSX.
bugRegister.rootCause: Pruned prototype handler left in component body.

bugRegister.title: Orphaned component files in src/components/ui/ (demo.tsx, auth-section-1.tsx)
bugRegister.expected: Only active production components should reside in src/components/ui.
bugRegister.actual: demo.tsx and auth-section-1.tsx are unreferenced by any page or layout.

bugRegister.title: Duplicate footer implementations (PapumbaFooter.tsx vs SiteFooter.tsx)
bugRegister.expected: A single consolidated footer component should be used across all routes.
bugRegister.actual: Both files contain ~400 lines of duplicate SVGs, puppet assets, and links.
bugRegister.rootCause: Parallel development of redesign without consolidating existing footer.
bugRegister.recommendation: Standardize all pages on SiteFooter and remove PapumbaFooter.

bugRegister.title: Unused prototype route /new-design exposed to users
bugRegister.expected: Prototype routes should be redirected or guarded.
bugRegister.rootCause: Temporary development route left in router tree.

bugRegister.title: Agentation annotation developer tool loaded unconditionally in production RootLayout
bugRegister.expected: Developer annotation toolbar should only mount in development environment.

bugRegister.title: AudiobookModal missing volume persistence across sessions
bugRegister.expected: Audio mute/unmute state should stay consistent with global AudioContext.
bugRegister.actual: AudiobookModal manages its own isolated isMuted state rather than syncing with AudioContext.
bugRegister.recommendation: Connect AudiobookModal audio state to AudioContext.
